verdict.rationale: Netlify's own docs claim auto-deploy on every push, with preview URLs per PR, and support starting projects from a Git repository. Independent community reports corroborate automated builds and deploys via the GitHub integration, including preview builds of every PR. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation of the Git-triggered build configuration (branch selection, build settings, supported Git providers beyond GitHub).

support.subject: As a developer, I can automatically deploy my app on every Git push

citations.quote: Auto-deploy on every push. Every PR gets a preview URL.
Start a new project with an AI agent, a Git repository, or drag and drop.
The GitHub/Slack integration, automated builds and deploys, and rewrites/reverse proxy support work great.
The killer feature is the GitHub integration that renders a preview build of every PR.
